checkpoint_rule: final fixed-budget checkpoint; root decides arm adoption from complete evidence
confirmation_selection_rule: Among quality/trace/both with positive completed-score/raw delta in both development replicas, aggregate gain >=25 points/raw and pooled mean played score >=baseline, select largest aggregate completed-score/raw gain. Tie priority trace,quality,both. Confirm chosen arm against baseline with 3 fresh replicas, 256 train and 128 eval each. If none qualifies, retain current release state and report optional mechanisms experimental without a confirmatory sweep.
primary: completed episode score per raw generation attempt; incomplete episodes, failures and replay rejections count zero
interpretation: A generated-policy run includes novelty and syntax failures; fixed controls choose legal actions on every seed.

reused_baseline.reason: Only executed_credit+unplayed gate changed; baseline has executed_credit=False.
